title: Reskin gauss
statement: A runner's training plan adds one lap each day: $1$ lap on day $1$, $2$ laps on day $2$, and so on. How many laps has the runner done in total after $40$ days?
hints: Compare the first day with the last.
Use the arithmetic series trick: pair days so each pair has the same total.
solution: Pair day $k$ with day $41 - k$: each pair totals $41$ laps and there are $20$ pairs, so the total is $820$. Why this works. arithmetic-series-sum: pairing first with last makes every pair total the same.
